description: This Java source file defines an Akka actor named 'ThingsAggregatorActor' that handles aggregation of 'Thing' retrieval commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages retrieval requests, constructs command sources, and handles messaging between actors for thing data aggregation.

classes.name: ThingsAggregatorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for aggregating Thing retrieval requests, handling commands such as RetrieveThings and SudoRetrieveThings, and managing the asynchronous retrieval and response stream of Thing data.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method to create Props configuration for spawning a new ThingsAggregatorActor with a specified target actor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Overrides AbstractActor.createReceive to define message handling for RetrieveThings, SudoRetrieveThings, and unknown messages.

methods.name: retrieveThings
methods.description: Handles RetrieveThings command, extracts selected fields, and initiates result retrieval.

methods.name: retrieveThings (overloaded for SudoRetrieveThings)
methods.description: Handles SudoRetrieveThings command similarly to RetrieveThings, initiating retrieval based on provided thing IDs.

methods.name: retrieveThingsAndSendResult
methods.description: Constructs sources of retrieved Thing data based on IDs, wraps commands, and sends a stream ref back to the requester.

methods.name: calculateParallelism
methods.description: Calculates the level of parallelism for requests based on maximum configured parallelism and number of Thing IDs.
